curricula.structure: 30 one-credit courses, arranged in three-course specializations: 15 credits of breadth (five specializations, two of which are admission pathways) and 15 credits of electives.
curricula.elective_rule: Electives must include at least four complete specializations: either five elective specializations, or four plus three standalone one-credit electives.
